mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS "postId", title, is_pinned AS "isPinned", TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" FROM tb_board_post WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND board_type_code = 'NOTICE' AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, created_at DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.tenant_id, d.sales_order_id, SUM(d.supply_amt) AS supply_amount, SUM(d.total_amt) AS total_amount FROM tb_sales_order_dt d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY d.tenant_id, d.sales_order_id ) detail ON detail.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND detail.sales_order_id = h.sales_order_id
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "orderCount", COALESCE(SUM(detail.supply_amount), 0) AS "supplyAmount", COALESCE(SUM(detail.total_amount), 0) AS "totalAmount" FROM tb_sales_order_hd h
WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND h.order_dt >= CAST(#{from} AS date) AND h.order_dt <= CAST(#{to} AS date)

SELECT TO_CHAR(h.order_dt, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS "orderCount", COALESCE(SUM(detail.supply_amount), 0) AS "supplyAmount" FROM tb_sales_order_hd h
WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND h.order_dt >= CAST(#{trendFrom} AS date) AND h.order_dt <= CAST(#{to} AS date) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(h.order_dt, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month
mapper.sql: FROM tb_sales_order_hd h JOIN tb_sales_order_dt d ON d.sales_order_id = h.sales_order_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(d.delivery_dt, h.delivery_dt) >= CAST(#{dueFrom} AS date) AND COALESCE(d.delivery_dt, h.delivery_dt) <= CAST(#{dueTo} AS date)
mapper.select:
SELECT due.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", due.order_no AS "orderNo", c.customer_name AS "customerName", TO_CHAR(due.delivery_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "deliveryDt" FROM ( SELECT h.sales_order_id, h.tenant_id, h.order_no, h.customer_id, MIN(COALESCE(d.delivery_dt, h.delivery_dt)) AS delivery_dt
GROUP BY h.sales_order_id, h.tenant_id, h.order_no, h.customer_id ) due LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = due.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = due.tenant_id ORDER BY due.delivery_dt, due.sales_order_id LIMIT 5
